minimalCompletenessFindings: 16 of 39 submissions pass. The highest failing total is 7.5 and the lowest observed passing total is 9. The inclusive threshold is 8. Formula-only work earns 1 and qualitative direction alone earns 3. Even with full credit elsewhere, a general momentum-difference formula, a quotient without applied duration, or a signed force without physical interpretation can each yield at most 7.5. Conversely, an exact numerical expression, operands defined elsewhere, a momentum balance or a consistently reversed axis can establish the full calculation. The criterion weights preserve that distinction while allowing isolated arithmetic and unit slips. The three submissions that assert constancy or a specific instantaneous force each earn 7.5 under the explicit single deduction.
